in_sanskrit.name: Briddhi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wisdom, Intelligence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Briddhi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Briddhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'briddh', which means 'to grow' or 'to increase'. This name is often given to a child born on a day when the moon is in the constellation of Jyestha, which is believed to bestow intelligence and wisdom upon the child.
